status: pre-registered research targets; not experimental results or compute authorization

evaluation.split_unit: original source scene; all crops, aliases and generated variants inherit split
evaluation.teacher_exposure: Unknown; project-held-out is not proof of globally unseen data

metrics.geometry: No resizing or upsampling; exact paired dimensions; native or eligible center-512/768/1024
metrics.lpips_status: Unavailable until network, weights hash, input normalization and spatial reduction are pinned; missing values remain null
metrics.aggregation: Equal weight per original scene; seeds/repeats nested within scenes

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive uncertainty; not independent tiles or timed repeats

systems_gate.rule: Both saved RGB PNG MAE and max absolute error must be <= observed matched M0 repeat variation + 1e-12; source/data/runtime must match
systems_gate.baseline_limits: Measured from same-protocol M0 repeats; never widened after candidate results
systems_gate.scope: Numerical systems changes only; eligibility is not final acceptance

A.lpips_near_zero_rule: Inconclusive until an absolute ceiling is registered before results
additional_requirements: same hardware, geometry and batch size
measure deployment parameters and checkpoint bytes separately

B.alternate_lpips_primary: Requires a new pre-run configuration: >=5% relative LPIPS reduction and PSNR delta >= -0.2 dB; no retrospective choice

success_paths: full native output coverage on at least one larger tier that full-frame reference cannot process within the same GPU budget
at least 20% boundary-band error reduction versus plain tiling while preserving quality/detail
C.detail_rule: No observed fine-detail collapse; report boundary gradient error and fixed visual crops
C.coverage_rule: Keep reference OOM/timeouts in denominator; pair comparisons on explicit intersection, candidate absolute quality on declared full coverage

heldout_policy.requires: Frozen finalist checkpoint/config hashes, geometry, metrics, rejection criteria and approved budget before test execution
heldout_policy.checkpoint_selection: Separate corpus-validation PSNR, then SSIM, then earlier update
heldout_policy.development_use: Every cross-domain decision recorded; development is not training data

failure_policy.oom: Record failure; no silent geometry, precision, batch or policy fallback
